title: Billing variance & root-cause workbook (QBR prep)
summary: Working workbook to surface billing variance by route/customer, diagnose root causes for unexpected token spend, and produce clear QBR talking points and playbook actions.
action_items: Run per-route delta SQL for last 90 days — owner: Diego (due 2025-02-18)
Build stacked chart of cohort burn vs plan entitlements — owner: Nina (due 2025-02-20)
Draft budget-alert email and Slack snippet for customers exceeding 120% of forecast — owner: Ava (due 2025-02-14)
Add canary rate-limit policy template to repo — owner: Samir (due 2025-02-21)
alert_playbook_steps: 1) Automated alert fires when 3-day moving average spend > forecast by 25% OR hourly rate_limit_hits > 5% of requests. 2) Run fast-check queries to attribute to routes, models, or customers. 3) Apply temporary soft-limit (notify) then hard-limit if >50% over forecast persists. 4) CS outreach + technical troubleshooting with SRE/solutions. 5) Postmortem and QBR slide.
example_scenarios: Large spike from a single customer after new feature launch (root cause: unbounded batch generation)
Gradual drift across cohort due to model change increasing avg tokens/request
Traffic reroute increasing calls to expensive model variant in EU region
recommended_thresholds: monthly_spend_alert: 120% of forecast; hourly_rate_limit_hit_alert: >3% of requests; cache_hit_rate_warning: <40%; days_of_runway_alert: <14 days at current burn
escalation_contacts: Ops SRE Pager - ops-sre@redwood.ai - PagerDuty: PD-ops
sample_queries: SELECT date, route, model, SUM(tokens) AS tokens FROM token_events WHERE date BETWEEN '{{start}}' AND '{{end}}' GROUP BY 1,2,3;
SELECT customer_id, SUM(cost_usd) as spend FROM billing WHERE month = '{{month}}' GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 20;
SELECT hour, COUNT(*) filter (where rate_limit_hit=true) / COUNT(*) AS rate_limit_pct FROM request_logs WHERE date='{{day}}' GROUP BY hour;
slack_alert_templates: :warning: Billing watch: {{customer}} exceeded forecast by {{pct}}% over the last 3 days. CS owner: {{owner}}. See details: {{link}}
:info: Rate-limit spike detected on route {{route}} — {{rate_limit_pct}}% hits. Suggested action: apply soft-limit and notify customer.
notes: Open questions: should we default to model-level or route-level forecasts? Need to align with finance for forecast baseline. Consider adding an 'agent' column to trace SDK clients. Attachments to prepare for QBR: per-customer slide, top-5 anomalous requests, and playbook excerpt.
